name: gh-forge-path
description: Eval-only: puts the gh-forge stand-in first on the run's Bash PATH (fixtures/gh-forge/install.sh)

hooks.command: d="$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)/eval-forge/bin"; if [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && [ -x "$d/gh" ]; then printf 'export PATH="%s:$PATH"\n' "$d" >>"$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; fi
